network.tdh.profile.title: Explain my TDH
network.tdh.profile.intro: Look up a public profile or wallet to follow its latest stored calculation. No wallet connection is needed.
network.tdh.profile.input: Profile handle, ENS name or wallet address
network.tdh.profile.refreshing: Refreshing TDH… The previous snapshot stays visible until the update finishes.
network.tdh.profile.empty: Enter a profile or wallet to see its holding days, edition weights, boost and final total.
network.tdh.profile.notFound: No TDH snapshot was found for this profile or wallet. Check the name or address, or try again after the next daily calculation.
network.tdh.profile.error: The TDH snapshot could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
network.tdh.profile.dateNote: This is the calculation time, not the block’s timestamp. Profile displays can briefly differ while the daily update is being published.
network.tdh.profile.matched: The rounded token contributions below add up exactly to this snapshot’s final TDH.
network.tdh.profile.mismatch: The available token detail does not reconcile to the stored total. The total above is the API’s snapshot value; refresh after the daily update finishes.
network.tdh.profile.zero: This snapshot has no positive TDH. A newly acquired copy needs a whole holding day before it starts contributing.
network.tdh.profile.boostNone: No additional collection boosts in this snapshot.
network.tdh.profile.boostPrecision: Bonuses are added to the starting multiplier. The final multiplier is rounded to two decimal places.
network.tdh.profile.noHoldings: No holdings from this collection in the snapshot.
network.tdh.profile.tableNote: Whole days are summed across copies. Base TDH preserves the calculator’s wallet-level rounding; final TDH rounds base × multiplier for each token ID.
network.tdh.profile.agesNote: Only copies with positive whole holding days are listed. Newly acquired copies can appear in the balance before they appear here.
